title: Good could be even better
review: Very helpful app. Please consider giving the option to remove the picture background so the writing would be easier to read. Also it would be very useful to have a share feature next to each prayer so one could share with others through social media.

title: User friendly

title: Very useful app.
review:
Well thought out and organized. It is helpful if the duas are recited a little slow, for those who are not familiar with such duas. Or, you may add a speed control widget. 
Also a repeat button will help to read duas multiple times without touching the play button.
